problem: The App can lose the terminal TTS failure when a chunked PCM connection closes before its final chunk; it also collapses clean-terminal failures into a shorten-text suggestion.
hypothesis: The App only queries /v1/requests after byte iteration returns normally. A real streaming error throws before that query, while the coordinator has already recorded the safe failure code.
scope: Preserve authoritative terminal errors through a bounded authenticated status lookup; use typed request records, reject mismatched identity/kind, retain the transport error when no terminal failure is available, preserve cancellation and partial-audio rejection.
required_regressions: Real native HTTP late generation_limit, timeout and inference failure preserve the same safe message for WAV and streaming PCM
A failed streamed request retains no exportable WAV or playback ownership and the same service accepts a later successful request
Safe terminal messages survive status lookup; unrelated raw errors remain sanitized
Cancellation does not launch diagnostic work or replace output-device errors
Existing successful streaming, replay, device interruption, update drain and cancellation contracts remain passing
protected: Production App/service/config/Token, all original models, frozen artifacts and earlier shared diagnostic objects
excluded_acceptance: No TTS content-quality, natural mixed-speech, physical listening, strict 7200s M4, public download or distribution pass inferred
